title: Check Mac hardware stats with istats
summary: Use the `istats` command to view real-time hardware statistics like CPU temperature, fan speeds, and battery status. This tool is useful for monitoring system health and detecting overheating.
prerequisites: istats must be installed (e.g., via Homebrew)

steps.explain: Run `istats` to display all available hardware statistics, including CPU, fans, and battery.
steps.expect: A list of hardware stats including temperatures and fan speeds.

steps.explain: Run `istats cpu` to view only CPU-related statistics.
Run `istats fan` to view only fan speed statistics.
Run `istats scan` to scan and print all detected temperature sensors.
steps.expect: A list of temperature sensors and their current readings.
